title: Customer Care System Reference: Home Delivery Charge on Paid-in-Full Ridgeline Special Order Services Orders
content:
**Applies to.** The home delivery charge on a Ridgeline Special Order Services order in a program whose deposit at order is 100 percent of the order total (paid in full when the order is placed) that Ridgeline has delivered to the customer's address. The charge is due once the order has been delivered, and it is billed once on the order as a home delivery fee line.

**Business effect.** Billing the charge adds one home delivery fee line, dated today, to the order's ledger and raises the order's balance due by the charge. The customer sees the delivery charge as a new line on the order and a higher balance due.

## Tool: `bill_prepaid_delivery_3669e7a4`

**Capability.** Bills the home delivery charge on a special order that Ridgeline has delivered to the customer's address: one call adds one home delivery fee line, dated today, and raises the balance due by the charge.

**How it is invoked.** This is an agent-side tool. The agent unlocks it with `unlock_agent_discoverable_tool` and then calls it with `call_agent_discoverable_tool`, giving the tool name `bill_prepaid_delivery_3669e7a4` and the parameters below.

**Parameters.**

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `special_order_id` | the reference number of the special order being charged, as returned by the special order lookup for this customer | identifier, as returned by the lookup |
| `delivery_charge` | the home delivery charge to bill | US dollars as a plain number with 2 decimal places (for example 42.10); the tool rounds to the nearest cent; 0.00 bills a zero-amount line |

Neither parameter has an enumerated set of values.

**Return.** A confirmation sentence that begins "Home delivery charge billed" when the line was recorded, carrying the fee line reference number (text starting "sofee"), the special order number, the charge billed (US dollars, 2 decimals) and the order's new balance due (US dollars, 2 decimals, negative when money is owed back).

## Reference questions

**Does one call bill more than one line?** No. Each call adds one home delivery fee line.

**What does a call with 0.00 do?** It records a zero-amount home delivery fee line; the balance due does not change.

**Illustration (hypothetical values).** Calling with `special_order_id` set to the order's reference number and `delivery_charge` 42.10 on an order whose balance due was 0.00 returns a sentence reporting a charge of 42.10 and a balance due of 42.10.
